articles.title: India Beat Pakistan by 19 Runs to Defend Asian Games Cricket Gold
articles.excerpt: Abhishek Sharma's 61 and Tilak Varma's unbeaten 51 powered India to 211/6 before the spinners held off Hasan Nawaz's 96 in a 19-run final win at Nisshin.
articles.nri_angle: The final froze two time zones at once — morning in the US, evening in India — with diaspora WhatsApp groups as commentary boxes; the win keeps India on track for LA 2028, where the diaspora will be among the loudest in the stands.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India-Pakistan Cricket Final and Hockey Semi-Final Set Asian Games Viewership Records
articles.excerpt: The Olympic Council of Asia said Sunday that the two India-Pakistan clashes at Aichi-Nagoya drew the biggest broadcast audience in Asian Games history — and India won both matches before taking gold in each sport.
articles.image_caption: Two Indian hockey players celebrate during a match at the FIH Hockey World Cup in 2026. India beat Pakistan 4-3 in the Asian Games hockey semifinal at Aichi-Nagoya, one of two India-Pakistan clashes the Olympic Council of Asia called the most-viewed in the event’s history.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora audiences from New Jersey to Dubai form a large share of the global viewership for India-Pakistan fixtures, making this weekend's double-header and record audience a shared cultural moment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Appan Chale Punjab Medal Lai Ke': Baljeet Kaur's Video Goes Viral After Hockey Gold
articles.excerpt: The India hockey star's Punjabi message to fans after the team's 1-0 Asian Games final win over China became an internet favourite.
articles.image_caption: Indian hockey defender Baljeet Kaur, whose celebratory video went viral after India's Asian Games gold
articles.nri_angle: A Punjabi hockey star's viral video in her mother tongue turned India's Asian Games gold into a shared celebration for Punjabi communities worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Seals Fourth at Asian Games With 85 Medals After Late Gold Rush
articles.excerpt: India finished fourth at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday, winning 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze medals after a late two-day surge that delivered historic firsts in archery and golf.
articles.image_caption: The medal standings graphic from the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 shows India in fourth place with 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze medals. India finished ahead of fifth-placed Uzbekistan after a late gold rush across the final two days of competition.
articles.nri_angle: Nagoya's Indian community watched a 48-hour gold rush carry India from outside the top 10 to fourth, with historic firsts in women's archery and golf and multiple LA 2028 Olympic berths booked.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Asian Games 2026 Medal Tally: 85 Medals, Sport by Sport, With One Day to Go
articles.excerpt: India has 85 medals — 21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze — after Day 14 in Aichi-Nagoya, with archery leading the gold count and athletics contributing the most medals overall.
articles.image_caption: A graphic depicts the Asian Games medals. India had won 85 medals — 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze — after Day 14 of the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
articles.nri_angle: The 2026 campaign is India's deepest Asian Games showing beyond cricket, with teenagers like Kumkum Mohod already sealing Los Angeles 2028 quotas — names worth knowing before the next Olympics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Pranavi Urs Honoured at NDTV IGPL Pro-Am After Historic Asian Games Golf Gold
articles.excerpt: Days after becoming the first Indian woman to win an individual Asian Games golf gold, the 23-year-old received a standing ovation at the NDTV IGPL Golf Pro-Am, where a ₹1 crore cash prize was announced for her.
articles.image_caption: Pranavi Urs holds her gold medal and the Asian Games mascot at the medal ceremony in Aichi-Nagoya. She became the first Indian woman to win an individual Asian Games golf gold, finishing at 15-under 265 at the Kasugai Country Club.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, Urs' gold gives India's growing golf pipeline — from US and UK junior circuits to collegiate tours — a visible landmark in a sport where the community's presence keeps rising.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kapil Dev Lauds India's 'Much Better' Team After Asian Games Gold Over Pakistan
articles.excerpt: The 1983 World Cup-winning captain congratulated the young Indian side after its 19-run win over Pakistan sealed a cricket double gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.
articles.image_caption: Kapil Dev speaks to ANI at a golf event. The 1983 World Cup-winning captain congratulated India's men's cricket team after its 19-run win over Pakistan sealed the Asian Games gold medal.
articles.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora, the cricket double gold adds a rare multi-sport dimension to sporting pride, with cricket now contributing directly to India's Asian Games medal tally.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Teen Archer Kumkum Mohod Wins Historic Asian Games Recurve Gold, Seals LA 2028 Olympic Quota
articles.excerpt: The 17-year-old beat South Korea's Oh Yejin 10-8 in a shoot-off to become the first Indian woman to win the Asian Games individual recurve title, after securing India's LA 2028 quota place earlier in the day.
articles.nri_angle: A 17-year-old Indian defeating Korean archery dominance on her Asian Games debut is a story made for the global Indian diaspora, which will watch her LA 2028 qualification run with special interest in Los Angeles itself.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: No Handshake, No Trophy, No Apology: India Face Pakistan in Asian Games Cricket Final
articles.excerpt: The gold-medal match on Saturday in Nagoya carries the sport's fiercest rivalry into the Asian Games — with India's no-handshake stance intact and Mohsin Naqvi staying away from the presentation.
articles.image_caption: Indian players during the 2021 Test series against England at Headingley, Leeds. (Photo: Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: A must-watch for the global Indian diaspora, where India-Pakistan finals draw some of the largest television audiences of any sporting event.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fifteen India-Pakistan finals, one shared trophy: the complete record of the fiercest summit rivalry
articles.excerpt: From Miandad's last-ball six in Sharjah to India's Asia Cup triumph in Dubai, here is every India-Pakistan final across cricket and hockey — a ledger that stands level at seven wins apiece.
articles.image_caption: India's players celebrate beating Pakistan in the Asia Cup final in Dubai. The September 2025 win was India's first tournament-final victory over Pakistan in 18 years.
articles.nri_angle: India-Pakistan finals at neutral venues like Melbourne, Sharjah and Dubai are the diaspora's biggest shared sporting ritual, and the October 3 Asian Games gold-medal match gives overseas fans the 16th chapter at a fan-friendly hour.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India meet Pakistan in Asian Games cricket final as hockey, archery chase Olympic quotas
articles.excerpt: Saturday's penultimate day in Aichi-Nagoya brings the men's T20 cricket gold-medal clash against Pakistan at 10:00 AM IST, the men's hockey final against Malaysia at 3:30 PM IST, and recurve archery medal rounds carrying LA 2028 quota places.
articles.image_caption: India's men's cricket team at the Asian Games 2026. India faces Pakistan in the men's T20 final at 10:00 AM IST on October 3, defending the gold won at the Hangzhou Games.
articles.nri_angle: An India-Pakistan final is the biggest draw in world cricket for the Indian diaspora, with fans across the Gulf, UK and North America watching at dawn, and Saturday's cricket-hockey double gives overseas fans a rare shared day of reckoning with the home audience.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Parveen Hooda Completes Redemption With Asian Games Boxing Gold
articles.excerpt: Three years after a 22-month doping ban cost her a bronze medal and an Olympic dream, the Rohtak boxer beat Chinese Taipei's Chen Nien-chin 3-2 in the women's 65kg final, dedicating the gold to her father, who has battled throat cancer.
articles.image_caption: Boxer Parveen Hooda, who was stripped of her 2022 Asian Games medal before making a stellar return to reclaim gold. (File photo: The New Indian Express)
articles.nri_angle: For Indian fans and the diaspora following the Asian Games, Parveen's arc — a working-class Haryana family, a daughter funding her father's cancer treatment through her sport — is a familiar portrait of India's sporting pipeline.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Clinch Sepaktakraw Bronze After Narrow Semifinal Loss to Japan
articles.excerpt: India's men's quadrant team went down 0-2 to Japan in the sepaktakraw semifinal at Nagoya, securing the country's third Asian Games medal in the sport and its first in the quadrant event.
articles.image_caption: Members of India's men's sepaktakraw quadrant squad pictured at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. India went down 0-2 to hosts Japan in the semifinal on October 2 to take bronze — the country's third sepaktakraw medal at the Asiad and its first in the quadrant event.
articles.nri_angle: The bronze resonates with the Northeast Indian diaspora, whose communities champion sepaktakraw as a sport where their states lead the nation — a national podium finish validates that pride on Asia's biggest stage.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India vs Pakistan Asian Games Final: Predicted XIs, Key Battles, Match Details
articles.excerpt: India and Pakistan meet in the men's cricket gold medal match at the Asian Games 2026 on October 3 in Nisshin, Japan — with India favourites to retain the title after a 124-run semifinal rout of Sri Lanka.
articles.image_caption: India captain Shreyas Iyer and Pakistan captain Sahibzada Farhan pictured ahead of the Asian Games 2026 cricket final. The two teams meet for gold on October 3 at Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin, Japan — the first India-Pakistan final in Asian Games history.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora fans in the US/Canada face a 1 AM ET start for the India-Pakistan gold medal match, with global SonyLIV streaming expected to draw millions of overseas viewers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wanderers to Host 2027 World Cup Final and India–Pakistan Clash
articles.excerpt: The ICC has released the 2027 men's ODI World Cup schedule, with Johannesburg's Wanderers hosting both the India–Pakistan clash on October 10 and the final on November 21, and an official ticket ballot now open.
articles.image_caption: The Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, set to host the 2027 World Cup final
articles.nri_angle: The ICC's official ticket ballot, open from October 1 until November 21, gives diaspora fans in North America, the UK and the Gulf a fair, non-first-come-first-served shot at seats for the India–Pakistan game and the final at the Wanderers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Lovlina Borgohain Wins Gold on Her Birthday as India Powers Through Day 14
articles.excerpt: On her 29th birthday, Lovlina Borgohain beat China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 to win 75kg boxing gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games — while India's women's recurve team stunned South Korea for a historic first gold and Sujeet Kalkal reached the 65kg wrestling final.
articles.image_caption: Lovlina Borgohain celebrates after winning the women's 75kg boxing gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on October 2, 2026. The 29-year-old defeated China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 on her birthday, becoming only the second Indian woman after Mary Kom to win Asian Games boxing gold.
articles.nri_angle: Lovlina's birthday gold and the teenage heroics of Kumkum Mohod will resonate with diaspora audiences, who consistently engage most strongly with these landmark Indian sporting moments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: DDCA Calls DPL Corruption Claims Unverified, Refers Matter to Authorities
articles.excerpt: The association says Tehelka's match-fixing allegations are unsubstantiated and has asked the authorities to examine the matter through due process.
articles.nri_angle: Domestic T20 league integrity feeds directly into the IPL pipeline that diaspora fans follow closely; how the DDCA handles this inquiry will shape trust in the system.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Disgraceful': India's Umpire Pressure Sparks Storm After Narrow Japan T20 Win
articles.excerpt: A reversed wide call in the final over at Sano has drawn accusations that Indian players bullied the umpires — overshadowing a two-run win meant to celebrate 75 years of India-Japan ties.
articles.image_caption: India's Axar Patel speaks with the umpire during the T20I against Japan in Sano. A wide call off Patel's bowling in the final over was reversed after Indian players confronted the officials, drawing accusations of umpire intimidation.
articles.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans abroad are split between relief at the win and unease at the conduct, as the episode puts sportsmanship — not cricket — at the centre of India's Asian Games build-up.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mirabai Chanu, Manu Bhaker Lead India's Medal Hunt on Asian Games Day 5
articles.excerpt: Olympic medallists Mirabai Chanu and Manu Bhaker headline a packed Day 5 in Aichi-Nagoya, with at least eight medal events on Wednesday's schedule.
articles.image_caption: Mirabai Chanu competes in the women's 49kg weightlifting final at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. The Tokyo 2020 silver medallist is chasing India's first Asian Games weightlifting medal since 1998.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs following the Games get a full-day viewing schedule with two of India's most decorated Olympians chasing medals in prime morning hours IST.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Retain Asian Games Women's Cricket Gold With Record 147-Run Win Over Sri Lanka
articles.excerpt: Smriti Mandhana's 45-ball 79 — and a record 216 for 3 — powered India to a crushing 147-run victory over Sri Lanka in the final, the country's first gold of the 2026 Asian Games.
articles.image_caption: An India batter plays a shot during the women's cricket final against Sri Lanka at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. India won the final by 147 runs to retain the gold medal, the country's first gold of the 2026 Games.
articles.nri_angle: A second straight Asian Games gold — and India's first medal of the 2026 Games — gives the global Indian diaspora a marquee win to rally around, with Mandhana's record 11,000 international runs adding a historic individual milestone.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Thrash Korea 63-31 to Stay Unbeaten at Asian Games
articles.excerpt: A day after routing hosts Japan, India's kabaddi men dominated South Korea 63–31 in Nagoya to make it two wins from two in their title defence at the 2026 Asian Games.
articles.image_caption: Action from the India vs South Korea men's kabaddi match at the 2026 Asian Games. India won 63-31 at the Tokai Citizens Gymnasium in Nagoya on September 22 to stay unbeaten in Group A.
articles.nri_angle: Kabaddi is India's indigenous sport, and the men's ruthless title defence at the Asian Games — watched by a global diaspora — is one of the purest Indian success stories on the continental stage.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Face Japan in Historic First-Ever T20I at Sano
articles.excerpt: World No. 1 India warm up for the Asian Games against 41st-ranked Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at Sano, branded the Suzuki Cup — after rain washed out India's practice session and with no reserve day available.
articles.image_caption: Indian players celebrate during a T20 International. The reigning T20 World Cup champions face Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at the Sano International Cricket Ground on Tuesday 22 September, branded the Suzuki Cup.
articles.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Japan — one of Asia's fastest-growing Indian communities — Tuesday's match is a rare homecoming of Indian cricket on Japanese soil, while fans in India get a morning fixture that doubles as a cultural bridge between two partner nations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Chases Cricket Gold as Sindhu Leads Packed Asian Games Day 4 Schedule
articles.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's women face Sri Lanka for T20 gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while PV Sindhu's badminton squad meets hosts Japan and shooters Parth Mane and Elavenil Valarivan target a medal.
articles.image_caption: PV Sindhu at a felicitation ceremony after her Olympic silver medal. Sindhu faces Japan in her Asian Games 2026 badminton tie on September 22.
articles.nri_angle: Indian fans in Japan and streaming worldwide get their first full day of medal action, with the cricket final at a diaspora-friendly mid-morning IST slot.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chennai Super Kings Name Zaheer Khan Head Coach for IPL 2027
articles.excerpt: The five-time IPL champions ended Stephen Fleming's 16-year coaching era, handing former India pacer Zaheer Khan his first head-coach role on a one-year contract.
articles.image_caption: Zaheer Khan at a public event in Mumbai. The former India pacer has been named head coach of Chennai Super Kings for IPL 2027, succeeding Stephen Fleming after 16 years.
articles.nri_angle: CSK's enormous diaspora fanbase gets a new era to follow, with the franchise's US-based Texas Super Kings still searching for a coach of its own.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Women Face Sri Lanka for Gold in Asian Games Cricket Final
articles.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's defending champions meet Sri Lanka for the Asian Games women's cricket gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while boxer Sakshi Chaudhary opens against an Olympic medallist.
articles.image_caption: Members of the Indian women's cricket team during a match at the Asian Games. India faces Sri Lanka in the women's gold medal match on September 22 at Aichi-Nagoya.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian-Americans, the women's cricket final airs at a convenient 10:00 PM PDT on Monday, September 21, and stars like Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana draw heavy diaspora viewership.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Suchika Tariyal Wins Historic Bronze as MMA Debuts at Asian Games
articles.excerpt: The 36-year-old lost a disputed overtime semifinal to Singapore's Teo Hui Hoon but leaves Aichi-Nagoya with India's first Asian Games medal in mixed martial arts.
articles.image_caption: Suchika Tariyal holds the Indian flag aloft after her Brave CF 92 debut victory in December 2024. The 36-year-old won bronze in the women's traditional -60kg event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday, India's first-ever MMA medal at the Games.
articles.nri_angle: India's first Asian Games MMA medal arrives as the sport surges in global popularity, giving diaspora fight fans a homegrown name to follow on the international circuit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Praggnanandhaa Downs Giri as India Beat Netherlands at Chess Olympiad
articles.excerpt: R Praggnanandhaa declined a draw offer from Anish Giri and ground out his first win in Samarkand as the defending champions beat the Netherlands 3-1 — but India's top-seeded women lost 1.5-2.5 to Poland for the third straight Olympiad.
articles.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa defeated Anish Giri as India beat the Netherlands at the Chess Olympiad.
articles.nri_angle: The Rameshbabu siblings starred for India on opposite ends of a mixed day, and the top-board win came against Dutch No. 1 Anish Giri, born to a Nepali father in Russia.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Rout Japan 49-24 to Open Kabaddi Title Defence at Asian Games
articles.excerpt: Ashu Malik's three-point Super Raid set the tone as debutants starred in a dominant opening group-stage win at Nagoya's Tokai Citizens Gymnasium.
articles.image_caption: India's men's kabaddi team poses for a group photograph on the mat in their blue India jerseys. The defending champions opened their Asian Games 2026 title defence with a 49-24 win over hosts Japan in Nagoya.
articles.nri_angle: Kabaddi's Pro Kabaddi League has built a growing US fanbase; India's title defence gives diaspora viewers a team to follow through the Asian Games.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
